items.title: EU Chief Slams Russian ‘Atrocities’ After Kyiv Attack
items.description: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen condemned Russia’s latest deadly attack on Kyiv and said Ukraine will receive another €1.4 billion in profits generated from frozen Russian assets. The funds are part of a broader EU effort to make Moscow pay for its war and support Ukraine’s defense.

items.title: Russian missile and drone barrage in Ukrainian capital region kills 17
items.description: Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region killed 17 people and wounded 44 others overnight into Wednesday, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

items.description: 'Ballistic interceptors are what could have saved the lives of those killed today,' Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said, as Kyiv seeks more US-made Patriot interceptors.

items.title: US Senator Rick Scott: Putin 'Underestimated Trump's Commitment To Freedom'
items.description: In an interview with RFE/RL, Republican Senator Rick Scott said Russian President Vladimir Putin did not anticipate the strength of US support for Ukraine's war effort, adding that a new sanctions bill is meant to hold Russia accountable.

items.title: Gaza peace plan: Will US pressure Israel to accept it?
items.description: Reports suggest US President Donald Trump would be "very disappointed" if Israel doesn't agree to a new peace plan for Gaza, announced last week. But how far would the US go to make that happen?

items.title: Gaza ‘unsafe for civilians’ as Israeli attacks hit homes and classrooms
items.description: Gaza remains unsafe for civilians as Israeli attacks continue, including on schools and canvas classrooms, despite the October Israel-Hamas ceasefire that ended two years of war, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Tuesday.

items.title: Trump now says he will halt Iran strikes, having reached outline to end war
